title: POS Sync — inventory v1
description: Stock counts from a stocktake, or adjustments for breakage and deliveries. The mode is not cosmetic: an absolute count describes a STATE and an older one must never replace a newer one, while a relative adjustment describes a CHANGE and changes commute, so they are safe to apply in any order.

occurred_at.description: When the count was taken. For absolute counts this decides whether the count is still current or has been superseded, so an explicit offset is required.

mode.description: absolute: the counted level. relative: a delta. Defaults to absolute.

quantity.description: For absolute, the counted level (never negative). For relative, the delta, which may be negative.
